Production Zones Production Plan Adjustment Notice

To the Researchers and Production Line Supervisors in each Production Zone:
Given the upcoming Starflux Grand Prix, Astropolis is expected to see a short-term surge in demand for race cars. To ensure stable market supply, and following approval from the decision-making body of the production zones of the Life Sciences Institute, it has been decided that, effective from the date of this notice, production plans are to be adjusted accordingly. The relevant work requirements are as follows:

I. Production Plan Adjustments
Starting today, all imagenae-related production lines will switch to maximum production pace, with a target output increase to 150% of the current baseline. All work sections must follow the new shift schedule to ensure round-the-clock, uninterrupted operation of all equipment and Wishpower supply links. All supervisors are required to confirm and submit their schedules for the record within twenty system hours.

II. Imagenae Monitoring and Emergency Prep Requirements
During full-capacity operations, all research institutes must implement enhanced monitoring of imagenae on the production line, increasing the monitoring frequency to once every two hours. Key metrics to be recorded include stability levels, behavioral deviation rates, and metabolic decay indicators. Given the inherent individual variation that arises under high-intensity working conditions, any imagenae exhibiting significant performance degradation, response latency, or structural instability shall be flagged as "Pending Replacement" according to standard operating procedure. No further recovery attempts are required.

III. Optimization of Loss Handling Procedures
To support accelerated production capacity, loss handling procedures have been streamlined. Any imagenae confirmed to have lost operational efficiency are to be cleared directly through the end-of-line recycling channel, with the corresponding workstation immediately filled by a new imagenae from the standby sequence. All researchers are hereby notified that this step requires no dedicated reporting or approval. Simply note the loss quantity and the replenishment time in the shift handover log. As standardized components on the production line, the presence and removal of imagenae are both handled according to standard process protocols. Attrition rates will be factored into current-period performance metrics, and are not to be filed as abnormal occurrences.

IV. Personnel Response Conduct
All researchers must maintain open lines of communication. Upon detecting abnormal fluctuations in the production line, first ensure the orderly integration of new individuals before processing the exit records of any decommissioned imagenae. In the event of an emergency, contact your department supervisor immediately and report to Mastaka.
All units are to relay these instructions diligently and strictly implement them.

This notice shall take effect from the time of issuance.

Life Sciences Institute Production Zone Central Dispatch Center
